title: 幻潮女祭司角色表
author: Coder Junkie
categories: 游戏素材,漫画 / 分镜,水彩,水墨 / 中国风,插画,角色,文字 / 排版
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a single-page fantasy character sheet for Sera Vayne, a tide-priestess warrior with a ceremonial war glaive, elegant coastal mysticism, and high-detail concept art presentation.

Canvas: Wide landscape character design board, approximately 16:9, warm off-white parchment background with thin grey panel borders, painterly ink-and-watercolor fantasy concept art, refined but slightly weathered. Use a mostly neutral cream, deep blue-black, pale ivory, seafoam teal, warm tan, and bright bioluminescent blue palette.

Main hero pose: On the left third, show a full-body heroic standing pose of a barefoot adult woman with tanned skin, athletic slender build, long wild black wavy hair tied loosely back, layered necklaces, shell and bead ornaments, dangling earrings, and a calm ritual-warrior presence. She wears a pale translucent salt-white halter wrap dress with a high slit, a seafoam waist sash, wrapped forearm bandages, anklets, and a flowing tattered deep blue-black cloak that looks like wet tide fabric. She holds a tall ornate ceremonial glaive upright beside her; the blade is jagged, elegant, dark metal with glowing blue edges and carved wave-like ornament. Add subtle water-splash stains and ink textures around her hem.

Left title column: Add four large vertical Chinese characters down the far left with small English translations beside them: tide, silence, blade, body, return. Include a small red seal stamp beneath. At the bottom left, write the large brush-lettered name Sera Vayne, subtitle The Rite Before the Tide, and three small lore lines: ROLE: War Priestess · Tide Reader · Last of the Coastal Order; CORE THEME: The sea does not rage — it arrives. She moves the same way. Patient, total, final.; WEAPON: Tidecaller — ceremonial war glaive. The blade glows because the tide chose her.

Orthographic views: In the upper middle column, include exactly 3 labeled views: 1 FRONT full-body view with the glaive standing beside her, 2 BACK full-body view showing the cloak and hair from behind, 3 PROFILE side view showing her carrying the weapon. Use small star-like label markers and uppercase labels FRONT, BACK, PROFILE.

Expression sheet: In the upper right, create a boxed section titled EXPRESSIONS containing exactly 6 head-and-shoulder portraits in a 3-by-2 grid. Labels must be: 1 Ceremonial neutral, 2 Focused pre-strike, 3 Profile left, 4 Post-release, 5 Looking down, 6 3/4 right. Keep facial features consistent, hair loose and wet-textured, jewelry visible, and the same costume neckline.

Costume detail insets: In the center-right, create a boxed DETAILS section with exactly 4 vertical close-up panels labeled: 1 Waist & hip, 2 Neckline & collarbone, 3 Leg & hem, 4 Forearm & hand. Show fabric layering, shells, beads, sash knots, translucent cloth, tattered cloak edges, barefoot ankle jewelry, and wrapped forearm details.

Signature prop breakdown: On the right side, create a SIGNATURE PROP section showing the glaive diagonally from lower left to upper right, with callout arrows and labels for exactly 6 parts: blade, glow edge, engraving, grip wrap, shaft, butt cap. Add a small zoom-in box of the blade tip emphasizing carved metal and blue luminous edge.

Silhouette study row: Along the bottom center, include exactly 6 black silhouette thumbnails labeled: 1 Neutral standing, 2 Low sweep prep, 3 Overhead raise, 4 Aerial extension, 5 Kneeling finish, 6 Horizon facing. Make the silhouettes readable, dynamic, and varied, always including the long glaive and flowing cloak.

Color palette: On the lower right, include a COLOR PALETTE box with exactly 6 circular swatches and labels: 1 Deep Ocean Blue-Black — Ocean blue-black: ritual authority, depth, command; 2 Pale Salt White — Salt white: endurance, tide foam, worn grace; 3 Seafoam Teal with Gold — Seafoam teal: water connection, ceremonial rank; 4 Warm Tan — Warm Tan: grounded physicality, natural strength; 5 Bioluminescent Blue — Bioluminescent blue: the tide’s mark, living power; 6 muted shell-gold accent for ornaments and ceremonial details.

Style constraints: Make it look like a professional AAA fantasy character design sheet, painterly semi-realistic illustration, crisp section labels, thin panel lines, no extra characters, no modern objects, no UI mockup elements, no photorealistic studio lighting, no clutter beyond the specified sections.\

prompt_en: A dramatic black-and-white studio portrait of a confident bearded man wearing unique, thin-framed gold round sunglasses with dark tinted lenses and a tailored dark suit, captured in a close-up composition with a shallow depth of field. He is positioned slightly to the right side of the frame, photographed at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens look. His head is turned to the left in profile view, gazing off-camera with a calm, contemplative expression, chin slightly raised. His left hand is loosely clenched near his chin, adding intensity and sophistication to the pose. The lighting is classic Rembrandt-style side lighting, soft yet highly directional, creating deep cinematic shadows across the right side of his face and neck while illuminating the left side of his face, forehead, nose bridge, and knuckles. Strong catchlights in the eyes are essential. The portrait should feel moody, elegant, and editorial, with rich tonal contrast and crisp texture detail. His beard is meticulously groomed with visible individual hairs and realistic skin texture including pores, eyelashes, and subtle facial lines. He has a messy hair and wears a luxury metal wristwatch on his left wrist with reflective metallic surfaces, visible bezel details, and a polished bracelet. On the cuff of his dark jacket, a silver-toned Roman numeral “III” detail appears vertically in a bold serif style. The suit fabric is matte black with subtle folds and stitched cuff details. The watch crystal and metal edges catch highlights naturally while the clothing remains mostly matte. The overall palette is monochrome only: deep blacks, bright whites, and rich greys with very high contrast. The background is a dark studio backdrop with soft mottled texture fading into near-black shadows and a heavy vignette on the right side. Slight soft-focus blur appears in the extreme foreground near the bottom edge, adding depth and realism. Ultra-realistic photography, cinematic portrait style, luxury fashion editorial aesthetic, extremely detailed beard texture, realistic skin micro-details, sharp focus on the eyes and face, high dynamic range monochrome tones, no visible noise, no compression artifacts.\

Add 4 red seals total: 1 oval collector-style seal near the upper right margin and 3 square seals stacked vertically near the lower left inscription area. Include a faint monochrome ink-wash landscape in the lower right corner with 1 drooping willow tree and 1 small pavilion by the water, partially faded into the paper. title: 浮空夜市

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a richly detailed fantasy concept art scene of a floating night market above the clouds, blending steampunk airships, sky docks, and colorful bazaar tents.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 composition, cinematic wide-angle view, high fantasy digital painting with painterly realism, deep perspective, dramatic scale, no text or watermark.

Setting and atmosphere: A vast aerial marketplace suspended among thick white clouds at twilight or night. The sky is dark navy and stormy overhead, with heavy rolling clouds, while a pale glowing horizon cuts across the middle distance. The mood should feel magical, bustling, and slightly mysterious, with warm lantern light contrasting against cool blue moonlit clouds.

Layout: Foreground and lower half filled with wooden market platforms, bridges, railings, stalls, hanging fabric canopies, and crowds. Midground opens into a cloud-filled gap with more floating docks and ships. Background shows distant clouds and flying vessels receding into haze.

Counted major elements: Include exactly 3 visible airships: 1 large oval zeppelin-like ship on the upper left with a dark wooden gondola and many rigging cables, 1 smaller distant airship centered in the background, and 1 very large balloon-and-gondola airship docked on the upper right with a round vertical envelope, ropes, masts, and a projecting gangway. Include exactly 5 main market areas: 1 lower-left stall cluster beneath dark blue striped canvas, 1 center-lower wooden dock with lanterns and figures, 1 right-lower covered bazaar with striped awnings and food stalls, 1 middle-left floating market platform in the clouds, and 1 upper-right docked platform beside the large airship. Include many small human figures as a dense crowd of merchants and shoppers, but keep them tiny and atmospheric rather than portrait-like.

Subject details: Wooden floating piers should appear suspended in the sky with no visible ground, supported by fantasy engineering and partly hidden by clouds. Stalls sell spices, fruits, fabrics, trinkets, baskets, and glowing objects. Add draped cloth awnings in deep blue, teal, red, orange, purple, and gold. Use numerous warm hanging lanterns and street lamps throughout the scene, especially along railings and stall fronts. Add ropes, pennant strings, crates, barrels, tables, ladders, poles, and rigging to increase detail.

Visual style: Epic fantasy illustration, highly detailed, atmospheric lighting, ornate steampunk airship design, warm golden lantern glow, cool blue shadows, volumetric clouds, cinematic depth, intricate market clutter, painterly brushwork, sharp focal detail in the lower market and softer distant background.

Customization: The scene should depict a floating night market above the clouds with steampunk zeppelin airships, illuminated by warm golden lanterns against a stormy blue night sky, with canopies in deep blue, teal, red, orange, purple, and gold, and populated by tiny fantasy merchants, travelers, and shoppers.

Constraints: No modern buildings, no cars, no aircraft with wings, no readable signage, no sci-fi neon, no empty market; keep the image grand, dense, and vertical with the airships clearly above and behind the crowded bazaar.\

title: Y2K 未来派尖叫桌面

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a surreal Y2K-futurist Windows XP desktop remix of Edvard Munch’s The Scream, as if the painting is the actual computer wallpaper and the OS interface is floating on top.

Canvas: 4:3 desktop screenshot, 1024×768 feel, glossy late-1990s/early-2000s computer UI. Dominant palette is neon violet, ultraviolet, magenta, electric blue, black chrome, and orange sunset highlights. Everything should glow with CRT bloom, glassy transparency, scanline-like softness, and cyberpunk reflections.

Background wallpaper: Reimagine Edvard Munch’s The Scream as a futuristic neon harbor scene. The iconic bridge walkway runs from the lower left toward the center, wet and mirror-reflective with bright purple light strips. The sky is a swirling expressionist vortex of luminous purple, pink, orange, and blue strokes, like liquid fiber-optic trails. A futuristic city skyline rises across the water with glowing towers and reflections. Two dark human silhouettes stand on the bridge at left. In the lower center foreground, include the screaming figure in a glossy black chrome robe, hands raised to its face; the face area is covered by a flat muted mauve-gray rectangular block, like an intentional censor or missing image placeholder.

Desktop shell: Add a vertical icon column on the far left with exactly 8 desktop icons, each glowing purple-blue with small white lowercase labels: 1) my computer, 2) internet, 3) e-mail, 4) msn, 5) music, 6) pictures, 7) settings, 8) help, plus a trash can icon near the bottom labeled trash. Use chunky Y2K icon styling with glass orb effects.

Taskbar: Along the bottom, create a translucent purple Windows XP-style taskbar. On the far left is a rounded Start button with the Windows logo and the label start. On the far right system tray, include tiny status icons and the clock reading 11:11 PM.

Open windows: Include exactly 4 floating translucent purple application windows with pixel fonts, beveled borders, and small minimize/maximize/close buttons.

Window 1, upper left: A Microsoft Paint-style window titled “untitled - Paint”. It has a menu bar reading “File  Edit  View  Image  Options  Help”, a vertical tool palette on the left, a small canvas showing a mini version of the neon harbor skyline and swirling sky, and a color palette strip along the bottom with many purple, pink, blue, and gray swatches.

Window 2, upper right: A music player window titled “now playing”. It shows square album art of a neon city grid, the track information: “scream.wav”, “the angst mixtape”, “track 03”. Add a waveform visualization, progress time “01:42 / 03:24”, a progress bar, and three playback controls: previous, pause, next.

Window 3, middle right: A system info window titled “system.exe”. Text inside should read: “THE SCREAM.EXE”, “artist: edvard munch”, “year: 1893”, “remixed in: 3000”, “resolution: 1024x1280”, “color mode: neon rgb”, “size: 1.42 mb”, “status: existential”. Include a glowing purple wireframe skull/head graphic on the right and a segmented loading bar along the bottom.

Window 4, lower right: A notepad window titled “untitled - notepad”. Menu bar reads “File  Edit  Format  View  Help”. Body text reads exactly: “nothing is real”, “but the signal”, “and the scream”, blank line, “-//user”.

Visual style: Y2K futurism, cyberpunk vaporwave, translucent Windows XP interface, neon expressionist oil-paint texture. Make the interface crisp enough to read, but integrate it with the painterly, swirling neon environment. Use intense glossy reflections, purple rim lighting, glass panels, pixelated UI typography, and nostalgic early-internet aesthetics.

Constraints: No modern flat design, no photorealistic people, no extra windows beyond the 4 specified, no extra desktop icons beyond the listed icons and trash, no watermark, preserve the legibility of all visible UI text.\

Bottom row has 3 panels: bottom-left labeled 东北 with a green-framed panel for number 4 and text 四绿文曲星, plus 吉星: 学业、文昌、考试, illustrated with an open book, brush pen, and ink stone with bamboo leaves behind; bottom-center labeled 正北 with a gold-framed panel for number 6 and text 六白武曲星, plus 吉星: 权力、贵人、偏财, illustrated with a golden guardian lion statue on a pedestal holding a ball; bottom-right labeled 西北 with a gray-framed panel for number 2 and text 二黑巨门星, plus 凶星: 病痛、伤害、阻滞, illustrated with a stone pagoda and a small incense burner. Use exactly 6 outer direction labels around the grid: 东南, 正南, 西南 above the top row, and 东北, 正北, 西北 below the bottom row, each inside rounded capsules matching the panel colors. Add exactly 2 large vertical side direction labels outside the grid: 正东 on the left side and 正西 on the right side. At the bottom center, add a pill-shaped legend with 2 segments: a red segment reading 吉星: 1、4、6、8、9 and a dark gray segment reading 凶星: 2、3、5、7. title: 古代忍者人物解剖图
author: 肥虾
categories: 信息图 / 教育视觉,海报 / 传单,动漫 / 漫画,复古 / 怀旧,角色,图解 / 图表
prompt_en:
Goal: Create an antique parchment anime character analysis chart for Naruto, styled like an ancient ninja manuscript and role anatomy poster.

Canvas: Vertical 4:5 poster on aged tan paper with burnt, torn, darkened edges, ink stains, cracks, hand-drawn borders, weathered texture, and symmetrical decorative scrollwork. Use a sepia, black ink, orange flame, and blue chakra palette. The whole page should look like a detailed archival character dossier from a fantasy shinobi world.

Top header: Large bold black brush-calligraphy title centered, reading 【鸣人】, with a smaller subtitle plaque underneath reading character anatomy chart in Chinese-style lettering. Add two large decorative spiral emblems near the top left and top right, surrounded by smoky cloud patterns, plus small red seal stamps. Put narrow vertical side plaques near the upper corners with Chinese-style labels.

Main layout: Divide the poster into five tall vertical manuscript columns plus a right-side detail strip, each framed with thin black hand-inked borders and bracketed Chinese-style section headers. The five main columns are: 1) expression comparison, 2) appearance outfit, 3) ability structure, 4) desire core, 5) detail magnification and evolution path.

Column 1, expression comparison: Show exactly 2 stacked character portrait panels. The upper panel is a calm front-facing bust of the anime ninja in a black-and-orange jacket with spiky blond hair and whisker cheek marks; the face area may be softly blurred or simplified. The lower panel is an intense transformed fiery fox-chakra bust, with glowing orange aura, fierce eyes, whisker marks, and flame-like energy rising around the head. Add small bracket labels beside both portraits.

Column 1 lower section, trait icons: Show exactly 6 circular trait icons arranged in a 2 by 3 grid, each in its own small bordered square with a tiny label. The six icons are: clone silhouettes, flame drop, spiral vortex, seated sage silhouette, nine-tailed fox flame, and protective core emblem.

Column 2, appearance outfit: Full-body front view of the character standing upright, occupying most of the column. He has spiky blond hair, a black forehead headband, black-and-orange zip jacket, orange cropped shinobi pants, dark sandals, black ankle wraps, bandage wrap on one thigh, and a small pouch on one leg. Use clean anime line art but weathered ink texture. Add exactly 8 small annotation labels with leader lines pointing to outfit pieces: headband, hair, collar/zipper, jacket body, sleeve patch, pants, pouch, sandals.

Column 3, ability structure: Draw a glowing anatomical chakra diagram of the same standing body as a transparent golden outline. Show visible internal energy channels, circular chakra nodes, and a bright blue spiral core at the chest. Use exactly 7 labeled callouts pointing to energy features: crown chakra, clone technique, spiral orb, sage path, tailed beast force, sealing core, and nine-tailed power. Surround the body with smoky blue and gold energy lines.

Column 4, desire core: Create a tall dramatic illustration of an orange nine-tailed fox spirit made of fire and swirling chakra, looming from top to center. Below it, show a small dark silhouette of the hero facing the energy storm. Include exactly 5 labeled callouts: fire dream, spiral heart, unwillingness to yield, protective core, and inner beast. The column should feel the most chaotic, with dense flame curls and a large vortex near the lower center.

Right detail strip: Include two stacked subsections. The upper subsection is detail magnification with exactly 4 horizontal close-up boxes: metal forehead protector with spiral symbol, one blue eye close-up, hands holding a blue spiral energy orb, and golden chakra-flow pattern. The lower subsection is evolution path with exactly 5 stacked small portrait thumbnails connected by downward arrows: academy child, lower-rank ninja,疾风-era teen, sage mode, and nine-tail mode. Keep the thumbnails small and manuscript-like, with face areas simplified if necessary.

Bottom border decorations: Add exactly 5 bottom decorative elements: a large blue-black spiral vortex at bottom left, a rolled cylindrical scroll near the lower left-center, a central spiral medallion plaque, a kunai dagger angled beside a sealing paper tag, and a blue wave ornament at bottom right. Add a small centered bottom plaque with Chinese-style text, plus vertical plaques in the lower left and lower right corners.

Visual style: Highly detailed anime illustration mixed with ancient Chinese/Japanese scroll aesthetics, black ink outlines, brush calligraphy, faded red seals, hand-numbered chart feeling, ornate but readable compartments, grunge paper texture, subtle watercolor wash, glowing orange and blue magical energy. Use no modern UI elements, no photorealism, no clean white background, and no extra characters beyond the single character and symbolic fox spirit.\

title: 概念人群肖像装置艺术
author: 麻酱AI实验室
categories: 海报 / 传单,3D 渲染,极简主义,肖像 / 自拍,抽象 / 背景
prompt_en: based on a clear real-life photo uploaded by the user. ## I. Identity Requirements Strictly refer to the real identity characteristics of the person in the uploaded photo, including: - Facial contour - Facial proportions - Eye and brow structure - Nose shape - Lip shape - Hairstyle foundation - Skin tone and sense of age - Gaze and temperament - Overall character recognizability The final image must allow the viewer to immediately recognize the person from the uploaded photo. Do not turn them into a stranger, do not Westernize, do not idolize/beautify excessively, and do not generate a fake AI face. ## II. Core Concept Recreate the portrait as a large-scale conceptual installation art piece. The entire portrait head is composed of thousands of miniature people, arranged densely like a crowd formation. Through different positions, clothing shades, crowd density, and shadow variations, they collectively form the face, hair, features, glasses, beard, clothing outlines, and overall expression of the person in the photo. The image looks like a giant portrait made of a real crowd, or a contemporary art installation placed in a minimalist white space. ## III. Composition - Vertical composition, suitable for visual posters or conceptual covers. - Aerial view / Isometric top-down view. - The portrait head occupies the main subject of the frame. - Background is a minimalist pure white space with significant negative space. - A few small people are scattered around the portrait to enhance the sense of spatial proportion and realistic scale. - The crowd as a whole forms a clear outline, and facial features must be accurately placed. ## IV. Visual Elements ### Crowd Structure - Use dense crowds to form hair, eyebrows, eyes, bridge of the nose, lips, jawline, and clothes. - Dark-clothed people form hair, glasses, collars, and shadow areas. - Light-clothed people form facial highlights and skin areas. - The arrangement should be natural, with a realistic sense of crowding and small random variations. - Each miniature person should have an independent posture, clothing, and direction, avoiding a copy-paste look. ### Lighting Effects - Soft cinematic lighting. - Low-angle long shadows. - Natural shadows cast at the feet of the crowd. - Unified shadow direction to enhance spatial realism. - Overall clean, high-end, and quiet aesthetic. ### Color Style - Warm neutral tones. - Primarily off-white, light brown, gray, and charcoal black. - Dark clothing used to strengthen character outlines. - Skin areas transitioned with light beige and warm gray crowds. - Restrained color palette, avoiding excessive vibrancy. ## V. Art Style Overall style references: - Contemporary conceptual art. - Museum-grade installation art. - Hyper-realistic crowd simulation. - Minimalist visual posters. - High-end digital art. - Social metaphor visual works. - Cinematic conceptual photography. The image should have a strong visual metaphor: An individual's image is composed of countless tiny individuals, offering both the shock of a macro portrait and the explorability of micro-crowd details. ## VI. Mood Overall atmospheric keywords: - Surreal - Profound - Quiet - High-end - Modern - Thought-provoking - Cinematic - Visually shocking - Shareable ## VII. Rendering Quality - Ultra-high detail. - 8K texture. - Realistic crowd simulation. - Deep focus, ensuring the entire crowd portrait is clearly visible. - Rich details in miniature figures. - Realistic spatial proportions. - Clean image with no cluttered background. - High-end commercial visual quality. - Similar to Octane Render / high-end 3D conceptual rendering effects. ## VIII. Negative Constraints Please avoid the following: - Do not turn the person into a stranger. - Do not just generate a normal portrait. - Do not generate simple collages. - Do not let the crowd lose the portrait outline. - No misplacement of facial features. - No blurred facial structures. - No exaggerated cartoon style. - No low-resolution posters. - No messy backgrounds. - Do not make all miniature people look identical. - No text, watermarks, or logos. - No excessive beautification. - Do not change the person's sense of age or authentic temperament.\
